manifest.title_fil: Iugnay ang tao sa mahalagang serbisyo
objectives_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, itugma ang apat na fictional pangangailangan sa tamang serbisyo at sabihin ang referral at follow-up.
objectives_en: In a fictional case, match four fictional needs to the appropriate service and state referral and follow-up.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa silungan, apat na magkaibang pangangailangan ang pagkain, ligtas na tubig, regular na gamot at pagkabagabag.
sections.takeaway_en: At the shelter, food, safe water, regular medicine and distress are four different needs.

sections.takeaway_fil: Itugma ang apat na fictional pangangailangan sa tamang serbisyo at sabihin ang referral at follow-up.
sections.takeaway_en: Match four fictional needs to the appropriate service and state referral and follow-up.

sections.takeaway_fil: Iugnay ang bawat pangangailangan sa domain at itinalagang staff.
sections.takeaway_en: Link each need to its domain and assigned staff.

check.prompt_fil: Sabay-sabay ang apat na pangangailangan. Ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: Four needs arrive at once. What do you do first?

options.fil: Ikaw na ang humawak sa apat bilang iisang problemang medikal.
options.en: Handle all four needs yourself as one medical problem.

options.fil: Iugnay ang apat na domain sa itinalagang staff; itala ang naputol na serbisyo.
options.en: Link all four domains to assigned staff; record interrupted services.

options.fil: Pakuwentuhin muna nang buo at detalyado ang taong nababagabag.
options.en: Ask the distressed person to tell you the whole story first, in detail.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Kailangan ng WASH, nutrition at MHPSS staff ang tubig, pagkain at pagkabagabag, hindi lang medikal. 2: Napupunta ang bawat pangangailangan sa sariling domain at itinalagang staff. 3: Suriin muna ang kaligtasan; makinig lang nang may pahintulot, nang hindi pinipilit ang salaysay.
check.feedback_en: 1: Water, food and distress need WASH, nutrition and MHPSS staff, not only medical care. 2: Each need goes to its own domain and assigned staff. 3: Check safety first; listen only with consent, without demanding a story.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tubig sa WASH, pagkain sa nutrition, gamot sa clinician; mahinahong pakikinig at referral.
sections.takeaway_en: Water to WASH, food to nutrition, medicine to a clinician; calm listening and referral.

sections.takeaway_fil: Iugnay at iulat; huwag magreseta, magtakda ng ration, magdeklara ng ligtas na tubig o magbigay ng therapy.
sections.takeaway_en: Link and report; do not prescribe, set rations, declare water safe or give therapy.

sections.takeaway_fil: I-refer ang bawat pangangailangan at alamin kung paano babalik ang feedback.
sections.takeaway_en: Refer each need and confirm how feedback returns.

check.prompt_fil: Naipangkat mo na ang mga pangangailangan. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: You have sorted the needs. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Tratuhin ang lahat bilang isang medical case at magbigay ng sariling therapy.
options.en: Treat every need as a single medical case and give therapy yourself.

options.fil: Ipasa ang bawat pangangailangan sa focal person at alamin ang feedback.
options.en: Hand each need to its focal person and confirm how feedback returns.

options.fil: Sabihin sa mga pamilya na ayos ang tubig para hindi na sila mag-alala.
options.en: Tell families the water is fine so that they stop worrying.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: labas sa tungkulin ng BHW ang therapy at pagrereseta. 2: Sa referral na may daan ng feedback, posible ang follow-up. 3: WASH staff lang ang makapagsasabing ligtas ang tubig; iulat sa kanila ang alalahanin.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help: therapy and prescribing are outside the BHW role. 2: Referral with a feedback route makes follow-up possible. 3: Only WASH staff can say the water is safe; report the concern to them.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ipa-verify ang apat na service contact at alternatibo, at suriin ang access.
sections.takeaway_en: Verify four service contacts and backups, and check access.
